1_cavity_UP.label: cavity_UP_curve_on_bed
1_cavity_UP.verdict: REJECT — curved face on bed (violates bed rule); rim-only first layer

2_cavity_DOWN_curve_UP.label: cavity_DOWN_curve_UP
2_cavity_DOWN_curve_UP.verdict: CANDIDATE — curve off the bed; bowl needs light supports; mating rim / cavity features face down (may need supports under lips)
2_cavity_DOWN_curve_UP.supports: light tree/bowl supports in the R220 concave; optional supports under cavity-down lips/columns; brim on the (now flat-ish) outer roof islands
2_cavity_DOWN_curve_UP.why: Bed rule kept (nothing curved on bed). First layer is the former outer roof / tip patches — smaller than today's cavity-up bed, so watch adhesion.

3_side_print.label: side_print_curve_as_wall
3_side_print.verdict: REJECT as default — skin/seal face = vertical layers; weaker, leakier
3_side_print.supports: minimal, but quality on neck face is poor
